== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The Four Corners Rotation Pill is a highly valuable medicinal item used to facilitate the [[cycling]] of [[madra]]. These pills are characterized by a smooth texture with blue and white swirls, and they possess a scent reminiscent of rain and honey. Their primary function is to double the speed at which a user cycles their [[madra]], which significantly accelerates the expansion of their core and overall [[advancement]]. While they do not provide substantial external power compared to other items like the [[orus fruit]], their ability to enhance [[cycling]] is considered invaluable. When used in conjunction with a [[parasite ring]], the pill's benefits are doubled while maintaining a sensation similar to normal [[cycling]]. Due to their high cost, they are considered significant investments in training resources.}}
